'''Jeerag''' was a [[Advozse/Legends|Advosze]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He had a shop on the [[Promenade]], where he sold light [[Armor/Legends|armor]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Jeerag was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. He appears on Nar Shaddaa as an light armor vendor.
